title: Report On Peter Galkin, Serge Rogovoy And Jacob Wasserfuehrer

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 25,000-1-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. 3914
Special Branch S.S. Station,
Date: August 17, 1932.

Subject (in full) Peter Galkin, Serge Rorovoy and Jacob Wasserfuehrer.

Made by D.S. Tchoremschansky. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the Netherlands Consulate-General
letter of August 5, 1932 concerning Peter Galkin, Serge Rorovoy
and Wasserfuehrer inquiries made regarding these individuals
reveal the following :-

1) Peter Yakovlevich Galkin, Russian, native of Polteva
Province, South Russia was born in 1893. He is married and is
a musician by profession being able to play both the saxophone
and clarinet. He has two sons and a daughter. Galkin arrived
in Shanghai from Hankow in 1928 but returned to the latter city
sometime later. At present he is employed with the "International
Cafe" in Hankow. Nothing is known in this office against him.

2) Serge Rorovoy is unknown to this office but it is believed
that he is identical with one Savely Petrovich Rorovoi, Russian,
a native of Kiev, South Russia, born in 1900 who is at present
in Hankow. This individual who is married, is a professional
cellist. He arrived in Shanghai from Tsingtao in 1929 and was
employed in "Trachenko Cafe", No.405 Avenue Joffre. In May 1932
he proceeded to Hankow. Municipal Police records contain nothing
to his detriment.

3) Jacob Wasserfuehrer, Russian of Jewish origin, about 24 years
of age, professional drummer. In 1929 he arrived in Hankow
from Peking. In 1931 he came to Shanghai and obtained
employment with the Kavkaz Restaurant orchestra No.941 Bubbling
Well Road which was then conducted by one F. Ulshtein (file
No.D.1433). During May 1932 he returned to Hankow where he is
at present employed at the Hankow Race Club. Wasserfuehrer
who is not registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee or
any other like organization, is said to harbour pro-Soviet
tendencies.

Tchoremschansky
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

G. 25,000-1-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号 3914
特别分处，西捕站，
日期：1932年8月17日。

事由（全称）彼得·加尔金（Peter Galkin）、谢尔盖·罗罗沃伊（Serge Rorovoy）和雅各布·瓦瑟富勒（Jacob Wasserfuehrer）。

由 D.S. 乔雷姆尚斯基（Tchoremschansky）撰写。经 [签名] 转呈

关于荷兰总领事馆1932年8月5日来信，涉及彼得·加尔金、谢尔盖·罗罗沃伊和瓦瑟富勒一事，经查询上述人员，情况如下：

1) 彼得·雅科夫列维奇·加尔金（Peter Yakovlevich Galkin），俄国人，南俄罗斯波尔捷瓦省（Polteva Province）人，生于1893年。已婚，职业为音乐家，能演奏萨克斯管和单簧管。育有两子一女。加尔金于1928年从汉口抵沪，但不久后返回该地。目前受雇于汉口“国际咖啡馆”（International Cafe）。本处并无对其不利之记录。

2) 本处不知谢尔盖·罗罗沃伊（Serge Rorovoy）其人，但据信其与萨韦利·彼得罗维奇·罗罗沃伊（Savely Petrovich Rorovoi）为同一人，后者系俄国人，南俄罗斯基辅人，生于1900年，现居汉口。此人已婚，职业为大提琴手。他于1929年从青岛抵沪，受雇于霞飞路405号“特拉琴科咖啡馆”（Trachenko Cafe）。1932年5月，他前往汉口。市政警察档案中并无对其不利之记录。

3) 雅各布·瓦瑟富勒（Jacob Wasserfuehrer），犹太裔俄国人，约24岁，职业鼓手。1929年，他从北平抵达汉口。1931年，他来到上海，并在静安寺路941号高加索餐厅（Kavkaz Restaurant）乐队获得职位，该乐队当时由 F. 乌尔施泰因（F. Ulshtein）管理（档案编号 D.1433）。1932年5月，他返回汉口，目前受雇于汉口赛马会。瓦瑟富勒未在俄国侨民委员会或任何其他类似组织登记，据说怀有亲苏倾向。

乔雷姆尚斯基
D. S.
特别分处主管警官。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 2482

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3914
Date 5 / 8 / 32

SHANGHAI, 5th August 1932.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that the following
three musicians desire to go to Netherlands India :

Peter GALKIN, at present employed at the International
Café at Hankow,

Serge ROGOVOY, cellist and

Jacob WASSERFUHRER, drummer at the Hankow Race Club.

I have referred the applications of these persons to
the Netherlands Consulate at Hankow, but would feel obliged
if you could find whether anything is known against them
in police records against these persons, either from a
moral or political point of view. They appear to have lived
in Shanghai, but I regret not being able to say exactly
where and when.

Thanking you in anticipation,

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

（左侧批注：）
Forwarded to C.S.B.
Reg. 41

（底部手写批注：）
For enquiry and report please
& reference to C.S.B. register

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。
第 2482 号

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别分部登记处
编号 D 3914
日期 32年8月5日

上海，1932年8月5日。

先生：

谨此通知，下列三位音乐家希望前往荷属东印度：

彼得·加尔金（Peter GALKIN），现受雇于汉口国际咖啡馆，

谢尔盖·罗戈沃伊（Serge ROGOVOY），大提琴手，以及

雅各布·瓦瑟富勒（Jacob WASSERFUHRER），汉口赛马会鼓手。

我已将上述人员的申请转交荷兰驻汉口领事馆，但若贵方能查明警方档案中是否有针对这些人的道德或政治方面的不良记录，我将不胜感激。他们似乎曾在上海居住，但很遗憾，我无法确切说明地点和时间。

先此致谢，

T. P. 吉文斯（T. P. Givens）先生，
特别分处主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
华务秘书。

（左侧批注：）
转送刑事与特别分部。
登记 41

（底部手写批注：）
请查复并报告
并参考刑事与特别分部登记册

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3914
D. 19/8/32

August 18, 2.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge the
receipt of your letter No. 2192, dated August 5, 1932,
concerning Peter Yakovlevich Galkin, Serge Rogovoy,
and Jacob Wasserfuhrer, Russian musicians, and to
inform you that there is nothing against them in
the Municipal Police Records. Wasserfuhrer,
however, is reported to harbour pro-Soviet tendencies,
and is not registered with the Russian Emigrants
Committee or any other similar organization.

A copy of a Police report concerning
these three Russians is attached herewith.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Chinese Secretary,
The Netherlands Consulate-General
Shanghai.

（批：Attached.
Sent out '9/8
ASD）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别分部登记处
编号 D 3914
D. 19/8/32

8月18日，2点。

先生：

谨此确认收到您1932年8月5日第2192号来信，内容涉及俄国音乐家彼得·雅科夫列维奇·加尔金、谢尔盖·罗戈沃伊和雅各布·瓦瑟富勒，并告知您，市政警察档案中并无针对他们的不良记录。然而，据报瓦瑟富勒怀有亲苏倾向，且未在俄国侨民委员会或任何其他类似组织登记。

随函附上一份关于这三名俄国人的警察报告副本。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

特别分处主管警官。

华务秘书，
荷兰驻上海总领事馆
上海。

（批：已附件。
8月9日发出
ASD）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 2914
Date 22/8/32

No. 2314.
SHANGHAI, 20 August 1932.

Sir,

I wish to acknowledge the receipt of your letter
of the 18th instant No. D. 3914, regarding P. Y. Galkin,
S. Rogovoy and J. Wasserfuehrer, and to thank you for the
information contained therein.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

Reg
Attach to file
HB

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.
